column3: Independently reassess the same four responses and extracted claims to estimate intra-rater consistency.
REPEAT_RESPONSES: original task, answer and full evidence; EVIDENCE_DOCS: source abstracts; REPEAT_CLAIMS: blank manual annotation fields.
Open REPEAT_RESPONSES and read the task, generated synthesis and source context for RC01.
Use EVIDENCE_DOCS to inspect the evidence for the relevant Repeat ID.
Open REPEAT_CLAIMS; enter human support label, subtype, confidence, evidence document ID and justification in the mint columns.
Repeat independently for RC02, RC03 and RC04. Do not consult your first-pass labels or the automated judge comparison.
Save and return this workbook. The results can be joined to your original annotations via the unchanged Full Claim ID.
Do not edit the generated response or extracted claim text. Flag extraction issues in the written justification, if relevant.
This assesses intra-rater repeatability (same reviewer twice), not agreement between independent human reviewers.
